mainTopic: How can one act of forbidden relations make a person חייב for several separate prohibitions, given that רבי מאיר holds that one איסור cannot take effect on top of another? The answer is איסור מוסיף and איסור כולל. Then a new משנה brings a similar case about a daughter's daughter.
overview: The amud begins by asking how one act can make a man חייב for many separate איסורים, since רבי מאיר holds that one איסור cannot take effect on top of another. The גמרא answers that רבי מאיר does accept an איסור מוסיף (a prohibition that newly forbids other people) and an איסור כולל (one that covers everyone). It then walks through each איסור in the previous משנה's case of a daughter born from his own mother. Next, a new משנה lists seven איסורים for a man with his daughter's daughter, and the same counts apply to his wife's daughter and his wife's granddaughter. רבי יוסי adds אשת אב for the case where the man's father married her. The גמרא explains that the father could marry her through יבום, and that he 'transgressed' only a rabbinic שניה, since she was his כלת בנו. It then shows that רבי יוסי usually judges by the first איסור, but agrees to an איסור מוסיף, which here comes from the father's other son. A further משנה teaches seven איסורים for a mother-in-law. רבי יוחנן בן נורי counts the in-law mothers separately, and the רבנן say they are one שם. The גמרא links his view to סומכוס and begins quoting סומכוס's משנה, which continues on the next amud.

steps.title: How can several prohibitions stack up for רבי מאיר?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא challenges the previous משנה: רבי מאיר holds that one איסור cannot take effect on top of another, so how can a man be חייב for many prohibitions in one act?
steps.simpleTranslation: But רבי מאיר does not hold that a prohibition takes effect on top of another prohibition!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא attacks the previous משנה's list of many חטאות. רבי מאיר says that once a woman is already forbidden, a second איסור cannot take hold of her.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If she is already forbidden as his daughter, the later איסורים (brother's wife, married woman, and so on) should never take effect. So how can he be חייב for all of them? The גמרא needs to explain how the list is possible.

keyTerms.meaning: The discussion that explains and questions the משנה
A prohibition taking effect where another prohibition already exists
'But isn't it so that...?' This opens a challenge

steps.confusionAlert: This question is aimed at the previous משנה (about a man and his daughter), not at the new משנה that appears later in this section.

phrases.english: GEMARA:
But רבי מאיר does not hold
phrases.notes: The previous משנה, about a man and his daughter, follows רבי מאיר's view.

phrases.english: that a prohibition takes effect on a prohibition!

steps.triggerLanguage: וְהָא לֵית לֵיהּ לְרַבִּי מֵאִיר אִיסּוּר חָל עַל אִיסּוּר
steps.kashyaTarget: The previous משנה's ruling that one act brings several חטאות
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Under רבי מאיר, אין איסור חל על איסור, so only the first prohibition should apply.

steps.title: Added and all-inclusive prohibitions do take effect
steps.stepSummary: רבי מאיר rejects ordinary stacking of prohibitions, but he agrees that an איסור מוסיף and an איסור כולל do take effect.
steps.simpleTranslation: True, he does not hold that a prohibition takes effect on a prohibition. But an 'adding' prohibition and an 'including' prohibition he does accept.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers by narrowing the rule. רבי מאיר blocks plain stacking, but not when the new איסור adds people or covers everyone.
steps.deeperAnalysis: An איסור מוסיף makes the woman newly forbidden to people who could have married her before. Because it takes effect for them, it takes effect for him too. An איסור כולל works the same way, because it covers everyone in the world at once.

keyTerms.meaning: A prohibition that adds new people who are now forbidden
A prohibition that covers everyone at once

steps.whyThisMatters: These two tools explain every later step in this section, and they appear in many places across ש״ס.

phrases.aramaic: נְהִי דְּאִיסּוּר חָל עַל אִיסּוּר לֵית לֵיהּ,
phrases.english: Granted, he does not hold that a prohibition takes effect on a prohibition,

phrases.aramaic: אִיסּוּר מוֹסִיף וְאִיסּוּר כּוֹלֵל אִית לֵיהּ.
phrases.english: but an added prohibition and an including prohibition he does hold of.

steps.triggerLanguage: נְהִי דְּאִיסּוּר חָל עַל אִיסּוּר לֵית לֵיהּ
steps.terutzResolutionType: Limiting the scope of the rule
steps.terutzHavaAmina: רבי מאיר blocks every second איסור
steps.terutzMaskana: He blocks only plain stacking. Added and all-inclusive prohibitions do take effect.

steps.title: Daughter and sister at the same moment
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא sets up the case: a man fathers a daughter from his own mother, so the איסורים of daughter and sister begin at the same time.
steps.simpleTranslation: For example, he had relations with his mother and fathered a daughter, so the prohibitions of his daughter and his sister come together.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא begins showing how the case works. This first step explains the opening two prohibitions; the next steps add the rest.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Two איסורים that start at the very same moment do not have a 'first' one blocking the other, so both take effect. That explains how she counts as both בתו and אחותו.

phrases.aramaic: כְּגוֹן שֶׁבָּא עַל אִמּוֹ וְהוֹלִיד בַּת,
phrases.english: For example, where he had relations with his mother and fathered a daughter,
so that the prohibitions of his daughter and his sister
come together at the same time.

steps.triggerLanguage: כְּגוֹן שֶׁבָּא עַל אִמּוֹ וְהוֹלִיד בַּת
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Starts applying the answer to the actual case
steps.terutzMaskana: Daughter and sister take effect together because neither came first.

steps.title: She marries his brother
steps.stepSummary: Once she marries his brother, she becomes newly forbidden to his other brothers. Since that is an added איסור, it also takes effect for him.
steps.simpleTranslation: She married his brother. Since a prohibition was added toward the other brothers, a prohibition is added toward him too.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא adds the third איסור, אשת אחיו, and shows it works as an איסור מוסיף.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Before the marriage, his other brothers were allowed to marry her; now she is their brother's wife. Because the איסור is truly new for them, it also takes hold for him.

keyTerms.meaning: Since (one thing is true, the other follows)

phrases.english: She married his brother,
since a prohibition was added toward the brothers,
phrases.notes: His other brothers could have married her before; now she is their brother's wife.

phrases.english: a prohibition is added toward him.

steps.title: She marries his father's brother
steps.stepSummary: After that, she marries his uncle. That makes her newly forbidden to the uncle's other brothers, so the איסור of אשת אחי אביו also applies to him.
steps.simpleTranslation: She married his father's brother. Since a prohibition was added toward the other brothers of his father, it is added toward him.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא adds the fourth איסור, אשת אחי אביו, using the same 'added' logic.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Her new husband's brothers, his other uncles, are newly forbidden to her as their brother's wife. That new איסור lets the uncle's-wife איסור take effect on him as well.

keyTerms.meaning: The wife of his father's brother (his aunt by marriage)

phrases.english: She married his father's brother,

phrases.aramaic: מִיגּוֹ דְּאִיתּוֹסַף אִיסּוּרָא לְגַבֵּי שְׁאָר אֲחֵי אָבִיו –
phrases.english: since a prohibition was added toward the other brothers of his father,
it is added toward him.

steps.title: She is a married woman
steps.stepSummary: As a married woman she is forbidden to the whole world, so this איסור also takes effect for him.
steps.simpleTranslation: She is a married woman. Since a prohibition is added toward the whole world, it is added toward him too.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא adds the fifth איסור, אשת איש, which covers everyone.
steps.deeperAnalysis: This is the איסור כולל idea. A prohibition that falls on the entire world at once includes him as well, even though she was already forbidden to him.

phrases.english: She is a married woman,
since a prohibition is added toward the whole world,
it is added toward him as well.

steps.title: She becomes a נדה
steps.stepSummary: When she becomes a נדה, she is newly forbidden to her husband, so the נדה איסור also applies to him. This completes the list.
steps.simpleTranslation: She becomes a נדה. Since a prohibition is added toward her husband, it is added toward him too.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא adds the last איסור, נדה, and finishes explaining the previous משנה's whole list.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Her husband was permitted to her, and now he is forbidden, so this is a real איסור מוסיף. Through it, the נדה איסור takes effect on him too.

keyTerms.meaning: A woman in her menstrual state

steps.whatToRemember: Under רבי מאיר, a second איסור works only if it is new for someone (מוסיף) or covers everyone (כולל). Each איסור in the list is explained this way.

phrases.english: She becomes a menstruating woman,
since a prohibition is added toward her husband,
it is added toward him as well.

steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: All the איסורים in the earlier משנה take effect through מוסיף or כולל, so רבי מאיר's view is consistent.

steps.title: New משנה: seven prohibitions for a daughter's daughter
steps.stepSummary: A new משנה teaches that a man who sins with his daughter's daughter can be חייב for seven separate איסורים.
steps.simpleTranslation: One who has relations with his daughter's daughter is liable for her as his daughter's daughter, his daughter-in-law, his brother's wife, his father's brother's wife, his wife's sister, a married woman, and a נדה.
steps.whatsHappening: A new משנה opens with a case similar to the last one, this time about a granddaughter. It lists seven איסורים for one act.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The new names here are כלתו and אחות אשתו. The משנה does not spell out how each one can apply to the same woman; it follows the same pattern of added prohibitions explained for the previous משנה.

phrases.english: MISHNA:
One who has relations with his daughter's daughter

phrases.aramaic: חַיָּיב עָלֶיהָ מִשּׁוּם בַּת בִּתּוֹ, וְכַלָּתוֹ,
phrases.english: is liable for her as his daughter's daughter, and his daughter-in-law,
and his brother's wife, and his father's brother's wife,
and his wife's sister, and a married woman, and a menstruating woman.

steps.mimraCoreRuling: One act with a daughter's daughter can bring seven חטאות.

steps.title: רבי יוסי adds the father's wife
steps.stepSummary: רבי יוסי says that if his own father married her, he is also חייב for אשת אב.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי יוסי says: if the elder transgressed and married her, he is liable for her as his father's wife too.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי יוסי adds an eighth איסור to the list, in a case where his father married the girl.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The 'elder' is the man's father, who is the girl's great-grandfather. If the father married her, she also becomes אשת אב to the man, which adds one more איסור.

keyTerms.meaning: The elder, meaning the man's father

phrases.english: רבי יוסי says:
If the elder transgressed and married her,
phrases.notes: The 'elder' is his own father, the girl's great-grandfather.

phrases.english: he is liable for her as his father's wife.

steps.triggerLanguage: רַבִּי יוֹסֵי אוֹמֵר אִם עָבַר זָקֵן וּנְשָׂאָהּ
steps.mimraCoreRuling: If the man's father married her, the איסור of אשת אב is added as well.

steps.title: The same counts apply to a wife's daughter and granddaughter
steps.stepSummary: The משנה finishes by saying the same list of איסורים applies to a man with his wife's daughter and his wife's daughter's daughter.
steps.simpleTranslation: And likewise, one who sins with his wife's daughter, or with her daughter's daughter.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה closes its list. Everything said about his own daughter and his own daughter's daughter also applies to his wife's daughter and his wife's granddaughter.
steps.deeperAnalysis: With his own daughter he was חייב six times, and with his daughter's daughter seven times. Now the משנה says the same counts work for his wife's daughter and her daughter. The only change is that the first איסור becomes בת אשתו instead of בתו.

keyTerms.meaning: His wife's daughter (his stepdaughter), a Torah ערוה
Her daughter's daughter, meaning his wife's granddaughter

phrases.english: And likewise, one who has relations with his wife's daughter,
and with her daughter's daughter.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Finishes the משנה's list after רבי יוסי's addition
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The same counts of איסורים apply to his wife's daughter and his wife's daughter's daughter.

steps.title: How could his father ever marry her?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes רבי יוסי's case and asks how the man's father could marry her at all, since she was already married to the father's brother.
steps.simpleTranslation: The משנה teaches that he is חייב for אשת אב. But is she allowed to his father?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא goes back to רבי יוסי's case (step 9) and challenges it. How could the man's father marry this woman in the first place?
steps.deeperAnalysis: Earlier in the list she married the man's uncle, who is the father's brother. That makes her אשת אחיו (his brother's wife) to the father, and that is a Torah ערוה. A marriage to an ערוה does not take effect, so how could she ever become the man's אשת אב?

keyTerms.meaning: It teaches (the גמרא is quoting the משנה)
Is she permitted to him? (a challenge asking how this is even allowed)
His father's wife, a Torah ערוה

phrases.english: Gemara:

phrases.aramaic: קָתָנֵי: חַיָּיב עָלֶיהָ מִשּׁוּם אֵשֶׁת אָב.
phrases.english: It teaches: he is liable for her because of 'father's wife.'
phrases.notes: This is רבי יוסי's line from the משנה, back in step 9.

phrases.english: Is she permitted to him?
phrases.notes: 'Him' is the man's father. She was already his brother's wife, so how could he marry her?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges רבי יוסי's case from step 9
steps.kashyaTarget: רבי יוסי's case that the father married her
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: She is already אשת אחיו to the father, so the marriage should not take effect, and she could never become אשת אב.

steps.title: It happened through יבום
steps.stepSummary: רבי יוחנן answers that the father married her through יבום, after his brother died without children.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי יוחנן said: for example, where she fell to him for יבום.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי יוחנן answers the question. The father's brother died without children, so she came to the father for יבום, and then the marriage is allowed.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Usually a brother's wife is a ערוה. But when the brother dies with no children, the Torah commands יבום, and that removes the אשת אחיו איסור. So the father's marriage to her really takes effect, and she becomes his son's אשת אב.

keyTerms.meaning: Levirate marriage: a brother marries the widow of his brother who died childless
She 'fell to him,' meaning she became bound to him for יבום

phrases.english: Rabbi Yoḥanan said:
For example, where she fell to him for levirate marriage.
phrases.notes: His brother, the man's uncle, died without children, so she came to the father for יבום.

steps.terutzResolutionType: Narrows the case to a special situation
steps.terutzHavaAmina: She is a brother's wife, so the father could never marry her.
steps.terutzMaskana: Through יבום the marriage is allowed and takes effect.

steps.title: Then why does it say he 'transgressed'?
steps.stepSummary: If the father married her through יבום, which is a מצוה, why does רבי יוסי say he 'transgressed' and married her?
steps.simpleTranslation: If so, what does 'transgressed' mean?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges רבי יוחנן's answer. רבי יוסי's wording says the father 'transgressed,' but if this was יבום, he did nothing wrong.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי יוחנן made the marriage fully allowed. But the word עבר means he did something forbidden. So the answer seems to clash with the wording of the משנה.

keyTerms.meaning: If so (if your answer is right, then...)
He transgressed, meaning he did something forbidden

phrases.english: If so, what is 'transgressed'?
phrases.notes: רבי יוסי's words in the משנה were that the elder 'transgressed and married her.'

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the answer of step 12 from the משנה's wording
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: יבום is permitted, so the word 'transgressed' in the משנה would make no sense.

steps.title: He transgressed a rabbinic איסור of כלת בנו
steps.stepSummary: רבי יעקב explains that the father transgressed because she was his son's daughter-in-law, a שניה forbidden by the רבנן.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי יעקב said: he transgressed because of 'his son's daughter-in-law,' which is a שניה.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי יעקב answers the challenge. The marriage is allowed by Torah law, but the רבנן forbade it, and that is the 'transgression.'
steps.deeperAnalysis: Earlier she was married to the man's son, who is the father's grandson. So to the father she is כלת בנו, his son's daughter-in-law. That is not a Torah ערוה, so the marriage takes effect. But the רבנן made it a שניה, so marrying her was still wrong.

keyTerms.meaning: A 'secondary' relative, forbidden only by the רבנן and not by the Torah

steps.confusionAlert: Don't think 'transgressed' means the marriage didn't work. A שניה is only forbidden by the רבנן, so the marriage still takes effect, and she really is אשת אב.

phrases.english: Rabbi Ya'akov said:
That he transgressed because of his son's daughter-in-law,
a secondary relative.

steps.terutzResolutionType: Points to a different, rabbinic איסור
steps.terutzHavaAmina: If the marriage is allowed through יבום, there is no transgression.
steps.terutzMaskana: The Torah allows it through יבום, but the רבנן forbade her as a שניה, so he 'transgressed.'
steps.whyThisMatters: It shows that a rabbinic איסור can be 'transgressed' while the marriage still fully works, which is what רבי יוסי's case needs.

steps.title: A ברייתא: כלת בנו is a שניה
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא supports רבי יעקב: a man's own daughter-in-law is a Torah ערוה, but his son's daughter-in-law is a שניה, and the same pattern goes down all the generations.
steps.simpleTranslation: As taught in a ברייתא: his daughter-in-law is a ערוה, his son's daughter-in-law is a שניה. The same with his son's daughter and his son's son's daughter, down to the end of all generations.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a ברייתא as a source for רבי יעקב's claim that כלת בנו is a שניה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The ברייתא draws a line. The first level (his own daughter-in-law, his own son's daughter) is a Torah ערוה. The next level down (his son's daughter-in-law, his son's son's daughter) and every level after it is only a rabbinic שניה. That fits exactly with רבי יעקב's answer.

keyTerms.meaning: A relative forbidden by the Torah
Until the end of all generations, meaning every further generation down

steps.whatToRemember: The father could marry her through יבום, so she really is אשת אב. He still 'transgressed' only because, as his כלת בנו, she was a rabbinic שניה.

phrases.english: As it is taught in a baraita:
His daughter-in-law is a forbidden relative,
his son's daughter-in-law is a secondary relative.
And likewise you find with his son's daughter,
and with his son's son's daughter,
phrases.notes: This one is only a שניה, one level further down.

phrases.english: until the end of all generations.

steps.triggerLanguage: כִּדְתַנְיָא: כַּלָּתוֹ עֶרְוָה, כַּלַּת בְּנוֹ שְׁנִיָּה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Brings a source supporting רבי יעקב in step 14
steps.raayaObject: רבי יעקב's claim that כלת בנו is a שניה
steps.raayaSupportSource: A ברייתא listing כלת בנו and further generations as שניות

steps.title: Does רבי יוסי really hold that one prohibition can take hold on another?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא challenges the reading of רבי יוסי's view. In רבי יוסי's case the son is liable for several prohibitions, but a משנה shows that רבי יוסי judges a person only by the first prohibition that came upon him.
steps.simpleTranslation: Does רבי יוסי really hold that a prohibition takes effect on top of another prohibition? But we learned in a משנה: if someone did a sin that carries two death penalties, he gets the harsher one. רבי יוסי says he is judged by the first prohibition that came upon him.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks a question. רבי יוסי seemed to say the son is liable for several prohibitions at once, but in another משנה רבי יוסי says only the first prohibition counts.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If the son is liable both for his father's wife and for the other prohibitions, then new prohibitions must take hold on a woman who was already forbidden. That is איסור חל על איסור. But in סנהדרין, רבי יוסי says the sinner is judged by the first prohibition, which suggests the later one never took hold.

keyTerms.meaning: A prohibition taking effect on top of an existing prohibition
He is judged with the harsher punishment
The first prohibition (literally 'first bond') that applied to him

phrases.english: And does Rabbi Yosei hold
that a prohibition takes effect on a prohibition?
But didn't we learn in a משנה:

phrases.aramaic: עָבַר עֲבֵירָה שֶׁיֵּשׁ בָּהּ שְׁתֵּי מִיתוֹת –
phrases.english: If one committed a sin that carries two death penalties
he is judged with the harsher one.
Rabbi Yosei says: He is judged
by the first prohibition that came upon him.
phrases.notes: זיקה literally means a 'tie' or 'bond.' Here it means the prohibition that tied him first.

steps.triggerLanguage: וּמִי אִית לֵיהּ לְרַבִּי יוֹסֵי אִיסּוּר חָל עַל אִיסּוּר? וְהָא תְנַן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: After explaining how the father married her and why it was a transgression, the גמרא now questions whether רבי יוסי can hold that several prohibitions apply at once.
steps.kashyaTarget: The assumption that רבי יוסי holds איסור חל על איסור in the case of the father's wife
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The משנה in סנהדרין shows that רבי יוסי judges by the first prohibition only, which implies that later prohibitions do not take hold.

steps.title: A ברייתא shows רבי יוסי follows the first prohibition even when the second is harsher
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא spells out רבי יוסי's view. Mother-in-law first, then married woman: he is judged as a mother-in-law. Married woman first, then mother-in-law: he is judged as a married woman. This proves that the second prohibition does not take hold.
steps.simpleTranslation: And a ברייתא teaches: how did רבי יוסי mean 'judged by the first prohibition'? If she was his mother-in-law and later became a married woman, he is judged for his mother-in-law. If she was a married woman and later became his mother-in-law, he is judged for a married woman!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a ברייתא to make its challenge stronger. The ברייתא shows exactly how רבי יוסי's rule works.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Burning, the penalty for a mother-in-law, is harsher than strangulation, the penalty for a married woman. Yet when she was a married woman first, רבי יוסי still judges him only as a married woman. So the later prohibition of mother-in-law did not take hold at all, even though it is harsher, and this clearly shows רבי יוסי does not hold איסור חל על איסור.
steps.confusionAlert: Don't think רבי יוסי simply picks the lighter punishment. In the first case he picks the harsher one, burning. He always follows whichever prohibition came first in time.

phrases.english: And it was taught in a ברייתא: How did Rabbi Yosei say
he is judged by the first prohibition?
If she was his mother-in-law and then became a married woman
he is judged because of his mother-in-law.
If she was a married woman and then became his mother-in-law
he is judged because of a married woman!
phrases.notes: This is the punch of the question. Being his mother-in-law carries burning, which is harsher, yet that later prohibition doesn't count.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְתַנְיָא: כֵּיצַד אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹסֵי נִידּוֹן בְּזִיקָּה רִאשׁוֹנָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Strengthens the קשיא of step 16 by showing that the second prohibition is ignored even when it is harsher.
steps.raayaObject: The challenge that רבי יוסי does not hold איסור חל על איסור
steps.raayaSupportSource: A ברייתא explaining רבי יוסי's rule of זיקה ראשונה with the cases of a mother-in-law and a married woman

steps.title: רבי יוסי agrees that an expanding prohibition takes hold
steps.stepSummary: רבי אבהו answers that רבי יוסי agrees an איסור מוסיף can take hold on top of an existing prohibition. רבין reports the same answer from רבי יוחנן.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי אבהו said: רבי יוסי agrees when it comes to an expanding prohibition. And likewise, when רבין came, he said in the name of רבי יוחנן: רבי יוסי agrees when it comes to an expanding prohibition.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the challenge. רבי יוסי usually says a second prohibition does not take hold, but he makes an exception for an איסור מוסיף, so the case of the father's wife still works.
steps.deeperAnalysis: An איסור מוסיף is a new prohibition that forbids the woman more widely than before, for example to more people. Since it spreads to new ground, it also takes hold for the person who was already forbidden. The cases of mother-in-law and married woman in the ברייתא are not like this, but the father's wife in our משנה is. A second sage, רבי יוחנן through רבין, says the same thing, which backs up the answer.

keyTerms.meaning: An expanding prohibition, one that forbids the woman more widely than before
And likewise, the same thing was also said

steps.whatToRemember: רבי יוסי normally holds that a second prohibition does not take hold (אין איסור חל על איסור), but he agrees that an איסור מוסיף does. That is why the son in his case can be liable for several prohibitions.
steps.whyThisMatters: This sets the limit of רבי יוסי's rule. A prohibition that cannot normally take hold can still take hold when it spreads wider than before.

phrases.english: Rabbi Abbahu said:
Rabbi Yosei agrees regarding an expanding prohibition.
phrases.notes: An 'expanding prohibition' forbids her more widely than before. Because it spreads, it takes hold even where she was already forbidden.

phrases.english: And likewise, when Ravin came,
he said that Rabbi Yochanan said:
Rabbi Yosei agrees regarding an expanding prohibition.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רַבִּי אֲבָהוּ: מוֹדֶה רַבִּי יוֹסֵי בְּאִיסּוּר מוֹסִיף
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the קשיא of steps 16 and 17 by limiting רבי יוסי's rule.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Distinction: an exception to רבי יוסי's general rule
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Since רבי יוסי judges only by the first prohibition, he should never allow a second prohibition to take hold, so the son could not be liable for several.
steps.terutzMaskana: רבי יוסי's rule applies to ordinary prohibitions, but he agrees that an איסור מוסיף takes hold on top of an existing prohibition, so the father's wife prohibition applies as well.

steps.title: Which added prohibition applies in this case?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks where there is an איסור מוסיף in our case that would let the extra prohibition take hold according to רבי יוסי.
steps.simpleTranslation: What added prohibition is there here?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא just accepted that רבי יוסי allows an איסור מוסיף to take hold. Now it asks where such an added prohibition actually exists in our case.
steps.deeperAnalysis: An answer in general terms is not enough. The גמרא wants to see a real איסור מוסיף in this specific case. Otherwise רבי יוסי's rule that only the first prohibition counts would still block the extra liability.

phrases.english: What added prohibition is there here?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: It tests the answer of step 18 by asking it to point to an actual איסור מוסיף in the case.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Where exactly the added prohibition is in the case being discussed.

steps.title: The grandfather's other son creates the added prohibition
steps.stepSummary: The added prohibition comes from the grandfather's other son. Since a new prohibition is added toward that son, a new prohibition is added toward our man too.
steps.simpleTranslation: It is a case where the grandfather has another son. Since a prohibition is added with regard to that son, a prohibition is also added with regard to this man himself.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the question: the grandfather has another son, and that son gives us the added prohibition.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The 'סבא' here is the זקן of the משנה, our man's own father. When he marries the woman, she becomes אשת אב to his other son as well, our man's brother. Because the new prohibition reaches someone new, it is an איסור מוסיף. By the logic of מיגו, once it takes hold for that son, it also takes hold for our man, even though she was already forbidden to him.

keyTerms.meaning: 'Since': since something is true in one respect, it is true in another respect as well.
A son of the elder, meaning another son of our man's father (our man's brother).

steps.whatToRemember: An extra prohibition can take hold on top of an existing one if it newly forbids someone else at the same time. Through מיגו, it then counts for everyone it applies to.

phrases.english: Where there is another son of the grandfather,
phrases.notes: The 'grandfather' is the elder from our משנה, the man's own father, so this other son is the man's brother.

phrases.english: since a prohibition is added with regard to his son,
a prohibition is added with regard to him as well.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: It answers the question of step 19 and closes the discussion about רבי יוסי.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The grandfather's other son is newly forbidden to the woman, so the prohibition is מוסיף. Through מיגו it takes hold for our man too.

steps.title: One act with a mother-in-law can carry seven prohibitions
steps.stepSummary: A new משנה teaches that one who has relations with his mother-in-law can be liable for seven prohibitions. The same is true of the father-in-law's mother and the mother-in-law's mother.
steps.simpleTranslation: משנה: One who has relations with his mother-in-law can be liable for her because she is his mother-in-law, his daughter-in-law, his brother's wife, his father's brother's wife, his wife's sister, a married woman, and a נדה. The same applies to one who has relations with his father-in-law's mother or his mother-in-law's mother.
steps.whatsHappening: A new משנה begins. It describes a case where the same woman is forbidden to a man in seven different ways, so one act brings seven חטאות.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Each relationship listed is its own separate ערוה in the Torah, so each one counts as its own חטאת. The משנה adds that the same full list can also apply to the father-in-law's mother or the mother-in-law's mother.

keyTerms.meaning: A woman in her menstrual state of impurity.
A sin-offering, brought for an accidental sin that carries כרת.

steps.confusionAlert: The משנה does not mean every mother-in-law has all seven prohibitions. It describes an unusual case in which one woman ended up connected to the man in all of these ways.

phrases.english: MISHNA:
One who has relations with his mother-in-law
is liable for her because of his mother-in-law, and his daughter-in-law,
and his brother's wife, and his father's brother's wife,
and his wife's sister, and a married woman, and a menstruating woman.
And likewise one who has relations with his father-in-law's mother,
or with his mother-in-law's mother.

steps.triggerLanguage: הַבָּא עַל חֲמוֹתוֹ חַיָּיב עָלֶיהָ מִשּׁוּם חֲמוֹתוֹ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: A new משנה that continues the theme of one act bringing many חטאות.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: One act with a mother-in-law can bring seven separate חטאות. The same is true of the father-in-law's mother and the mother-in-law's mother.

steps.title: רבי יוחנן בן נורי counts the three in-law mothers separately
steps.stepSummary: רבי יוחנן בן נורי says that one who has relations with his mother-in-law can be liable separately for mother-in-law, mother-in-law's mother, and father-in-law's mother.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי יוחנן בן נורי says: One who has relations with his mother-in-law is liable for her because she is his mother-in-law, his mother-in-law's mother, and his father-in-law's mother.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי יוחנן בן נורי gives his own view. He treats the mother-in-law, the mother-in-law's mother, and the father-in-law's mother as three separate prohibitions, even when they are all in one woman.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The תנא קמא listed these relatives only as different possible women. רבי יוחנן בן נורי adds that if one woman is all three at once, each one counts as its own separate חטאת.

phrases.english: Rabbi Yoḥanan ben Nuri says:
One who has relations with his mother-in-law is liable for her

phrases.aramaic: מִשּׁוּם חֲמוֹתוֹ, וְאֵם חֲמוֹתוֹ, וְאֵם חָמִיו.
phrases.english: because of his mother-in-law, and his mother-in-law's mother, and his father-in-law's mother.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: A disagreeing opinion inside the same משנה.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Mother-in-law, mother-in-law's mother, and father-in-law's mother are separate counts, each bringing its own חטאת.

steps.title: The רבנן: all three are one prohibition
steps.stepSummary: The רבנן reject רבי יוחנן בן נורי's view. All three relatives fall under one single name of prohibition, so they bring only one חטאת.
steps.simpleTranslation: They said to him: All three of them are one name.
steps.whatsHappening: The other sages push back against רבי יוחנן בן נורי. They say the three relatives are really one prohibition, not three.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The mother-in-law and both grandmothers-in-law are all forbidden by the same פסוק about 'a woman and her daughter' (ויקרא 18:17). Since they share one name of prohibition, the act counts only once, even if the woman fits more than one of these descriptions.

keyTerms.meaning: One 'name', meaning one single category of prohibition, so it counts as one sin.

steps.whatToRemember: Separate חטאות come only from separate names of prohibition. Relatives that all come from one פסוק count as one.

phrases.english: They said to him:
All three of them are one name.
phrases.notes: All three are forbidden by one פסוק, ויקרא 18:17, so they count as one prohibition.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמְרוּ לוֹ שְׁלׇשְׁתָּן שֵׁם אֶחָד הֵן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: It rejects the opinion of רבי יוחנן בן נורי in step 22.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: Counting the three in-law mothers as three separate חטאות.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: All three come from one single prohibition, so they cannot be counted separately.

steps.title: רבי יוחנן בן נורי and סומכוס said the same thing
steps.stepSummary: רבי אלעזר, in the name of רבי הושעיא, says that רבי יוחנן בן נורי and סומכוס hold the same idea.
steps.simpleTranslation: גמרא: רבי אלעזר said in the name of רבי הושעיא: רבי יוחנן בן נורי and סומכוס said one thing.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא begins and links רבי יוחנן בן נורי's view to a ruling of another תנא, סומכוס. It is setting up a comparison that it will explain next.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The claim is that both תנאים follow one shared idea. As רבי יוחנן בן נורי's view shows, the idea is to count separately things that the רבנן treat as one name. We do not yet know which ruling of סומכוס is meant.

keyTerms.meaning: 'One thing': the same idea or the same legal approach.

phrases.english: GEMARA:

phrases.aramaic: אָמַר רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר אָמַר רַבִּי הוֹשַׁעְיָא:
phrases.english: Rabbi Elazar said that Rabbi Hoshaya said:
Rabbi Yoḥanan ben Nuri and Sumakhos
said one thing.

steps.triggerLanguage: רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן בֶּן נוּרִי וְסוֹמְכוֹס אָמְרוּ דָּבָר אֶחָד
steps.relationToPreviousStep: The גמרא opens its discussion of the משנה by linking רבי יוחנן בן נורי to סומכוס.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: רבי יוחנן בן נורי and סומכוס share one legal approach.

steps.title: Which ruling of סומכוס is meant?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא says that רבי יוחנן בן נורי's view is the one in our משנה. It then asks what סומכוס's matching ruling is and begins to quote a משנה.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי יוחנן בן נורי: that is what we said. סומכוס: what is it? As we learned:
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא points out that we already know רבי יוחנן בן נורי's view from our משנה. It asks which ruling of סומכוס matches it, then starts to quote that ruling. This line sets up what comes next.
steps.deeperAnalysis: To prove that the two תנאים agree, we must see סומכוס's own words. The word דתנן shows that the answer is a משנה elsewhere (חולין 82a), and its text comes right after this.

keyTerms.meaning: 'That which we said': pointing back to something already stated, here our משנה.

phrases.aramaic: רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן בֶּן נוּרִי – הָא דַּאֲמַרַן.
phrases.english: Rabbi Yoḥanan ben Nuri: that which we said.
phrases.notes: This means his view in our משנה, about the three in-law mothers.

phrases.english: Sumakhos: what is it?
As we learned in a משנה:
phrases.notes: The quoted משנה is in חולין 82a, and its words come next.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: It asks for the source of סומכוס's view so that the claim of step 24 can be shown.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Which ruling of סומכוס matches רבי יוחנן בן נורי's view.
